```{r}
#Part A
pharma <- read.csv("C:/Users/beanv/OneDrive/Desktop/Fundamental of machine learning/Pharmaceuticals.csv")
head(pharma)
str(pharma)
dim(pharma)
names(pharma)

pharma_num <- pharma[, c(
  "Market_Cap",
  "Beta",
  "PE_Ratio",
  "ROE",
  "ROA",
  "Asset_Turnover",
  "Leverage",
  "Rev_Growth",
  "Net_Profit_Margin"
)]
head(pharma_num)
summary(pharma_num)
colSums(is.na(pharma_num))

pharma_scaled <- scale(pharma_num)
head(pharma_num)
round(colMeans(pharma_scaled), 2)
round(apply(pharma_scaled, 2, sd), 2)

set.seed(123)
wss <- sapply(1:8, function(k) {
  kmeans(pharma_scaled, centers = k, nstart = 25)$tot.withinss
})
plot(
  1:8, wss, 
  type = "b",
  pch = 19,
  xlab = "Number of Clusters (k)",
  ylab = "Total Within-Cluster Sum of Squares",
  main = "Elbow Method for Pharmaceutical Firms"
)

library(cluster)
silhouette_scores <- sapply(2:8, function(k) {
  km <- kmeans(pharma_scaled, centers = k, nstart = 25)
  sil <- silhouette(km$cluster, dist(pharma_scaled))
  mean(sil[, 3])
})
data.frame(
  k = 2:8,
  Average_Silhouette = round(silhouette_scores, 3)
)

set.seed(123)
pharma_kmeans <- kmeans(
  pharma_scaled,
  centers = 3,
  nstart = 25
)
pharma_kmeans
pharma$Cluster <- factor(pharma_kmeans$cluster)
table(pharma$Cluster)
aggregate(
  pharma_num,
  by = list(Cluster = pharma$Cluster),
  FUN = mean
)
pharma[, c(1, ncol(pharma))]
table(pharma$Cluster)
cluster_means <- aggregate(
  pharma_num,
  by = list(Cluster = pharma$Cluster),
  FUN = mean
)
cluster_means[, -1] <- round(cluster_means[, -1], 3)
print(cluster_means)
```

```{r}
#Part C
table(pharma$Cluster, pharma$Median_Recommendation)
table(pharma$Cluster, pharma$Location)
table(pharma$Cluster, pharma$Exchange)
#For median recommendation, cluster 1 include the only strong buy recommendation while cluster 2 has the most hold recommendation. CLuster 3 has more moderate buy recommendation than hold. In location, Cluster 2 and 3 has mostly of US firms while cluster 1 is diversifying. For stock exchange, all firms in cluster 1 and 2 are listed on NYSE while cluster 3 includes four NYSE, one Amex and one NASDAQ.
```
